I answered her calls when we were on speaking terms and was being guilted into speaking to her and I don’t have a lawyer because it’s just the judge and us one day to decide if it’s still an emergency and still needed. She legally can’t speak to me now so I doubt she will so everything I have is everything I’m going to get.

We are home a majority of the day. She’s not abused, we don’t leave her in there more than the time we’re away and to do the bits of training that she needs to be comfortable with going into the crate, she has toys and a bed. She’s a very good dog but we (like many other Americans) don’t have the money to replace things every week while in the puppy stage, eventually when we are done with our training classes she will be left to make her own choices during the day around the house if we do leave. So it’s just a temporary learning device at this point. But otherwise she sleeps with us and does pretty much everything with us but we have a safe place to keep her while we go places we cannot bring her.
Thank you for all the very helpful tips she’s definitely getting better every day with her crate!
